1. Please examine your Statement of Account and advise us in writing of any errors/omissions within fourteen (14) days from the Statement Date. In the
absence of such notification from you, the Statement of Account shall be deemed conclusive evidence of your confirmation and acceptance of the
transaction therein.
2. Please be reminded to keep your statements for future reference. Retrieval of past statements that are more than 12 months from statement date are
subject to charges.
3. iFAST Financial Pte Ltd is a licensed dealer, custodian, financial adviser, CPFIS registered investment administrator, and provides portfolio
management services in Singapore.
4. iFAST Financial Pte Ltd is a member of SGX-ST Securities Trading and CDP Securities Clearing, and a registered CDP Depository Agent.
5. For any enquiries, please contact our hotline at +65 6557 2000 or email us at ifastadmin@ifastfinancial.com.
1. The valuations provided in this statement are for information purposes only; they are indicative and shown in your chosen statement currency. Foreign
exchange conversion rates used in the calculation are for reference only based on the statement's exchange rate and subject to market movements.
Market values are based on the available product quantity on statement date and the prices used for the valuation in this statement may be based on
the last available market price or prices provided to us by the relevant counter-parties. For securities where a market price is not available, the last
known market price or offer price (for Initial Public Offering) may be used.
2. The holdings do not reflect purchases made from other distributors or directly with fund managers.
Weighted Average Cost (WAC)
• WAC for Unit Trust, Stock, ETF investments = Total investment amount divided by quantity.
• WAC for Bond investments = Nominal Value x Transacted Price + (Processing Fee + GST) (excluding accrued interest paid).
Bond Holdings Information
• Unrealised P/L = Market Value + Interest Accrued - Investment Amount - Accrued Interest Paid.
Unit Trust Holdings Information
• IA refers to quantity purchased through iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator.
• Non-IA refers to quantity that are not held by iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator. The Non-IA details are for
information only. For further clarification, please check with your respective CPF Investment Bank, SRS operator or the CPF Board.
3. Securities are held on your behalf by iFAST and/or its appointed Custodian, hence the Securities are not registered in your name.
4. Orders that are not transacted as at Statement Date will not be included in this Statement. (Where order status is not 'Complete', the quantity or bonds
will not be reflected in the holdings)
5. TBD - To Be Determined.
6. The Cash Account and iFAST Auto-Sweep Account are not saving accounts and hence not protected by the deposit insurance scheme.
7. Cash Account interest is accrued daily and paid every quarter. Interest rates are subject to change without prior notice.
1. The fees stated are inclusive of GST (where applicable).
2. Wrap, platform, management, clean class and Auto-Sweep fee deductions take place in the month of January, April, July and October. When there is a
failed fee deduction, we will attempt to make a second fee deduction in the following month.
# For more information on wrap, platform, management, clean class and Auto-Sweep fees, please refer to the Fee Schedule or equivalent. Amount
deducted for these fees is the product of number of units and price.

HOLDINGS & TRANSACTIONS
1. The valuations provided in this statement are for information purposes only; they are indicative and shown in your chosen statement currency. Foreign
exchange conversion rates used in the calculation are for reference only based on the statement's exchange rate and subject to market movements.
Market values are based on the available product quantity on statement date and the prices used for the valuation in this statement may be based on
the last available market price or prices provided to us by the relevant counter-parties. For securities where a market price is not available, the last
known market price or offer price (for Initial Public Offering) may be used.
2. The holdings do not reflect purchases made from other distributors or directly with fund managers.
Weighted Average Cost (WAC)
• WAC for Unit Trust, Stock, ETF investments = Total investment amount divided by quantity.
• WAC for Bond investments = Nominal Value x Transacted Price + (Processing Fee + GST) (excluding accrued interest paid).
Bond Holdings Information
• Unrealised P/L = Market Value + Interest Accrued - Investment Amount - Accrued Interest Paid.
Unit Trust Holdings Information
• IA refers to quantity purchased through iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator.
• Non-IA refers to quantity that are not held by iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator. The Non-IA details are for
information only. For further clarification, please check with your respective CPF Investment Bank, SRS operator or the CPF Board.
3. Securities are held on your behalf by iFAST and/or its appointed Custodian, hence the Securities are not registered in your name.
4. Orders that are not transacted as at Statement Date will not be included in this Statement. (Where order status is not 'Complete', the quantity or bonds
will not be reflected in the holdings)
5. TBD - To Be Determined.
6. The Cash Account and iFAST Auto-Sweep Account are not saving accounts and hence not protected by the deposit insurance scheme.
7. Cash Account interest is accrued daily and paid every quarter. Interest rates are subject to change without prior notice.

GENERAL
1. Please examine your Statement of Account and advise us in writing of any errors/omissions within fourteen (14) days from the Statement Date. In the
absence of such notification from you, the Statement of Account shall be deemed conclusive evidence of your confirmation and acceptance of the
transaction therein.
2. Please be reminded to keep your statements for future reference. Retrieval of past statements that are more than 12 months from statement date are
subject to charges.
3. iFAST Financial Pte Ltd is a licensed dealer, custodian, financial adviser, CPFIS registered investment administrator, and provides portfolio
management services in Singapore.
4. iFAST Financial Pte Ltd is a member of SGX-ST Securities Trading and CDP Securities Clearing, and a registered CDP Depository Agent.
5. For any enquiries, please contact our hotline at +65 6557 2000 or email us at ifastadmin@ifastfinancial.com.
HOLDINGS & TRANSACTIONS
1. The valuations provided in this statement are for information purposes only; they are indicative and shown in your chosen statement currency. Foreign
exchange conversion rates used in the calculation are for reference only based on the statement's exchange rate and subject to market movements.
Market values are based on the available product quantity on statement date and the prices used for the valuation in this statement may be based on
the last available market price or prices provided to us by the relevant counter-parties. For securities where a market price is not available, the last
known market price or offer price (for Initial Public Offering) may be used.
2. The holdings do not reflect purchases made from other distributors or directly with fund managers.
Weighted Average Cost (WAC)
• WAC for Unit Trust, Stock, ETF investments = Total investment amount divided by quantity.
• WAC for Bond investments = Nominal Value x Transacted Price + (Processing Fee + GST) (excluding accrued interest paid).
Bond Holdings Information
• Unrealised P/L = Market Value + Interest Accrued - Investment Amount - Accrued Interest Paid.
Unit Trust Holdings Information
• IA refers to quantity purchased through iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator.
• Non-IA refers to quantity that are not held by iFAST Financial Pte Ltd as a CPFIS Registered Investment Administrator. The Non-IA details are for
information only. For further clarification, please check with your respective CPF Investment Bank, SRS operator or the CPF Board.
3. Securities are held on your behalf by iFAST and/or its appointed Custodian, hence the Securities are not registered in your name.
4. Orders that are not transacted as at Statement Date will not be included in this Statement. (Where order status is not 'Complete', the quantity or bonds
will not be reflected in the holdings)
5. TBD - To Be Determined.
6. The Cash Account and iFAST Auto-Sweep Account are not saving accounts and hence not protected by the deposit insurance scheme.
7. Cash Account interest is accrued daily and paid every quarter. Interest rates are subject to change without prior notice.
FEES
1. The fees stated are inclusive of GST (where applicable).
2. Wrap, platform, management, clean class and Auto-Sweep fee deductions take place in the month of January, April, July and October. When there is a
failed fee deduction, we will attempt to make a second fee deduction in the following month.
# For more information on wrap, platform, management, clean class and Auto-Sweep fees, please refer to the Fee Schedule or equivalent. Amount
deducted for these fees is the product of number of units and price.
